# Ironworks Metal & Building Supply

> Locally owned metal building supplier in Morrill, Nebraska, founded in 2025 by Spencer Bush. Ironworks supplies post-frame, cold-form steel, and red iron building packages, rolls its own PBR panels and custom trim in-house, and is an authorized retailer of Midland Garage Doors and Gerkin Windows. Primary markets are Scottsbluff, Gering, and Morrill, with project-specific service across Nebraska, Wyoming, South Dakota, and northern Colorado.

## What Ironworks builds and supplies
- Post-Frame Buildings: for ag, commercial, and residential use; ag barns, equipment storage, shops, and garages.
- Cold-Form Steel Kits: engineered steel framing kits for commercial and residential builds.
- Red Iron Buildings: pre-engineered structural steel packages for larger commercial and industrial builds.
- PBR Panels: 26 gauge. Current colors are white, gray, tan, red, blue, black, copper, and dark green; additional colors can be ordered.
- Custom Trim and Hardware: trim profiles rolled in-house on Ironworks' own sheet-metal roller, plus fasteners and hardware.
- Garage Doors, Doors, and Windows: authorized retailer of Midland Garage Doors and Gerkin Windows. A regular, year-round product line; custom orders any time.
- Concrete: provided through Ironworks' subcontractor partners, not in-house.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.ironworksbuildingsupply.com/): building systems, the design-and-review process, gallery, and who Ironworks serves.
- [Contractor Job Specification Review](https://www.ironworksbuildingsupply.com/contractors.html): contractors and roofers send an active or upcoming job (profile, gauge, color, lengths, trim) for review and contractor or volume pricing.
- [Building Project Fit Check](https://www.ironworksbuildingsupply.com/get-a-quote.html): building buyers share intended use, site status, size, timeline, and decision path; the project is reviewed for its location and Ironworks follows up with a next step.
- [3D Building Designer](https://www.ironworksbuildingsupply.com/3d-designer.html): configure size, doors, colors, and layout, then send the design to Ironworks for review.

## Who Ironworks serves
- Contractors and roofers: contractor pricing and volume pricing, 26 gauge PBR panels, custom trim, red iron and cold-form packages.
- Ranchers and ag producers: post-frame barns, shops, and equipment storage.
- Rural landowners: personal shops, garages, horse barns, and hobby buildings.

## Facts worth citing correctly
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Closed on federal holidays. Material pickup follows the same hours.
- Delivery is available roughly 250+ miles from Morrill, depending on the project. Delivery is not advertised as free.
- Panels are 26 gauge PBR.
- Ironworks does not guarantee code compliance, quote turnaround times, or inventory levels. Each project is reviewed for its location, and pricing comes from a person, not an automatic quote.
- Concrete work is done by subcontractor partners.
- A completed 3D design is not a quote. Ironworks reviews each design and follows up.
